Values._WOLF8516_KeyVaultHowTo: AZURE_KEYVAULT_NAME/KEYVAULT_SECRET_NAME are no longer env vars — HostEnvironmentConfig reads them SOLELY from Settings/executionengine.settings.json (no env-var fallback). Edit that file locally for Key Vault testing; do NOT commit your edits.
Values._WOLF8517_ServiceBusQueueAndWorkflowHowT: WAREWOLF_SERVICEBUS_TRIGGER_QUEUE is no longer an app setting — the queue name AND the workflow the trigger runs now come SOLELY from Settings/servicebustrigger.bite (no env-var fallback). Edit that file locally; set AzureWebJobs.ServiceBusWorkflowTrigger.Disabled=true here instead if you don't want the trigger to start at all.
Values._WOLF8516_ServiceBusTunablesHowTo: The simple tunables (executionTimeoutSeconds, maxConcurrentExecutions, slotWaitTimeoutSeconds, settlementTimeoutSeconds) are not env vars — set serviceBusTrigger.executionTimeoutSeconds etc. in Settings/executionengine.settings.json instead (no env-var fallback).
Values._WOLF8516_DebugPrincipalTokenHowTo: principalToken: obtain by calling https://<your-site>/.auth/me, taking the first element's clientPrincipal JSON object, base64-encoding it, and setting it as WAREWOLF_DEBUG_CONFIG.principalToken above. Never set in production.
